quests.instruction: It is breakfast time! We eat eggs and toast before school. What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 AM
quests.hint: Think about when we eat our very first meal of the day.
quests.explanation: 8:00 AM is in the morning. That's when families eat breakfast together!
quests.funFact: At 8:00 AM, the sun is already bright and birds are singing outside.

quests.instruction: It is bedtime! We put on cozy pajamas and go to sleep. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 PM
quests.hint: Look outside — is the sky dark or bright at this time?
quests.explanation: 9:00 PM is at night, when the sky is dark and it's time to sleep.
quests.funFact: At 9:00 PM, the moon is out and the stars begin to twinkle.

quests.instruction: It is lunchtime at school! What time is it?
quests.question: 12:00 PM
quests.hint: This time is right in the middle of the day.
quests.explanation: 12:00 PM is called noon — the middle of the day, when we eat lunch.
quests.funFact: 12:00 PM is also called "noon," when the sun sits highest in the sky.

quests.instruction: School is over and it is time to play at the park! What time is it?
quests.question: 4:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens in the afternoon, after school ends.
quests.explanation: 4:00 PM is in the afternoon, a perfect time to play outside.
quests.funFact: At 4:00 PM, playgrounds are full of children laughing and playing.

quests.instruction: The sun peeks up and a rooster crows good morning! What time is it?
quests.question: 6:00 AM
quests.hint: This is very early, right when the day begins.
quests.explanation: 6:00 AM is early morning, right when the sun begins to rise.
quests.funFact: At 6:00 AM, the sky often turns a soft pink and orange color.

quests.instruction: It is story time! We put on soft pajamas and pick a bedtime book. What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens a little before we go to sleep.
quests.explanation: 8:00 PM is in the evening, a cozy time for a bedtime story.
quests.funFact: At 8:00 PM, many families read one last story before lights out.

quests.instruction: Time to wake up and stretch out of bed! What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 AM
quests.hint: This is when the day first begins for most children.
quests.explanation: 7:00 AM is early morning, a great time to wake up and get ready.
quests.funFact: At 7:00 AM, many families are just starting to wake up together.

quests.instruction: The sun is high in the sky and our tummies say it's lunchtime! What time is it?
quests.question: 12:00 PM
quests.hint: Look for the clue that says the sun is at its very highest.
quests.explanation: 12:00 PM is noon, when the sun is highest and lunch is ready.
quests.funFact: On a sunny day at 12:00 PM, your shadow becomes very short.

quests.instruction: The house grows quiet and stars twinkle outside. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 PM
quests.hint: Everything is calm and the sky is dark by now.
quests.explanation: 9:00 PM is nighttime, when the house gets quiet and calm.
quests.funFact: At 9:00 PM, many stars are already twinkling in the night sky.

quests.instruction: The school bus rolls up and it is time to hop on! What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 AM
quests.hint: This happens right after breakfast, before school starts.
quests.explanation: 8:00 AM is in the morning, when many children ride the bus to school.
quests.funFact: At 8:00 AM, school buses are busy picking up children on their route.

quests.instruction: Friends meet at the playground to swing and slide. What time is it?
quests.question: 4:00 PM
quests.hint: Think about the part of the day right after school ends.
quests.explanation: 4:00 PM is in the afternoon, a fun time to play with friends outside.
quests.funFact: At 4:00 PM, many neighborhoods fill up with children playing outside.

quests.instruction: The whole family sits down together to eat dinner. What time is it?
quests.question: 6:00 PM
quests.hint: This meal happens after playtime, when the sky starts to get darker.
quests.explanation: 6:00 PM is in the evening, a warm time for families to eat together.
quests.funFact: At 6:00 PM, kitchens everywhere smell like a warm dinner cooking.

quests.instruction: The teacher rings the bell and morning class begins. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 AM
quests.hint: This is soon after breakfast, when school starts for the day.
quests.explanation: 9:00 AM is in the morning, the usual time school begins.
quests.funFact: At 9:00 AM, classrooms fill up with children ready to learn.

quests.instruction: After lunch, everyone sits down for quiet reading time. What time is it?
quests.question: 1:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens right after we finish eating lunch.
quests.explanation: 1:00 PM is in the early afternoon, a calm time to read after lunch.
quests.funFact: At 1:00 PM, many classrooms turn quiet for reading time.

quests.instruction: Time for a warm, bubbly bath before bed! What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens in the evening, after dinner is finished.
quests.explanation: 7:00 PM is in the evening, a splashy time for a warm bath.
quests.funFact: At 7:00 PM, bathtime bubbles help children feel calm before bed.

quests.instruction: The class takes a break to eat a small snack. What time is it?
quests.question: 10:00 AM
quests.hint: This little break happens after class starts, before lunch.
quests.explanation: 10:00 AM is mid-morning, a good time for a small snack break.
quests.funFact: At 10:00 AM, many schools give children a snack to keep them energized.

quests.instruction: It is quiet rest time and everyone lies down on their mats. What time is it?
quests.question: 2:00 PM
quests.hint: This calm time is in the afternoon, after lunch is over.
quests.explanation: 2:00 PM is in the afternoon, a peaceful time to rest.
quests.funFact: At 2:00 PM, resting for a little while helps children feel refreshed.

quests.instruction: Everyone brushes their teeth before climbing into bed. What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens in the evening, right before we fall asleep.
quests.explanation: 8:00 PM is in the evening, time to brush teeth before sleeping.
quests.funFact: At 8:00 PM, clean teeth help you have a healthy smile every morning.

quests.instruction: The class gets out crayons and paints for art time. What time is it?
quests.question: 11:00 AM
quests.hint: This creative time happens late in the morning.
quests.explanation: 11:00 AM is late morning, a colorful time to paint and draw.
quests.funFact: At 11:00 AM, classroom walls are often covered in fresh new artwork.

quests.instruction: The final bell rings and it is time to go home. What time is it?
quests.question: 3:00 PM
quests.hint: This is when the school day ends, in the afternoon.
quests.explanation: 3:00 PM is in the afternoon, the usual time school finishes.
quests.funFact: At 3:00 PM, school hallways get busy as everyone heads home.

quests.instruction: The room is dark and everyone is fast asleep. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 PM
quests.hint: This is very late — the darkest, quietest part of the night.
quests.explanation: 9:00 PM is nighttime, when most children are sound asleep.
quests.funFact: At 9:00 PM, a good night's sleep helps children grow strong.

quests.instruction: We pour milk over crunchy cereal for breakfast. What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 AM
quests.hint: This is our very first meal, early in the day.
quests.explanation: 8:00 AM is in the morning, a tasty time for cereal and milk.
quests.funFact: At 8:00 AM, many families enjoy a bowl of cereal together.

quests.instruction: Everyone washes their hands before sitting down for lunch. What time is it?
quests.question: 12:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens right in the middle of the day.
quests.explanation: 12:00 PM is noon, the middle of the day when lunch begins.
quests.funFact: At 12:00 PM, washing hands before lunch keeps everyone healthy.

quests.instruction: The sun begins to set as the family sits down to eat. What time is it?
quests.question: 6:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens in the evening, as the sky starts to change color.
quests.explanation: 6:00 PM is in the evening, when the sky glows as dinner begins.
quests.funFact: At 6:00 PM, the sky often turns orange and pink at sunset.

quests.instruction: We brush our teeth and get dressed to start the day. What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 AM
quests.hint: This is early morning, right after we wake up.
quests.explanation: 7:00 AM is early morning, a great time to get ready for the day.
quests.funFact: At 7:00 AM, getting dressed quickly helps us start the day on time.

quests.instruction: Nap time begins right after lunch is finished. What time is it?
quests.question: 1:00 PM
quests.hint: This restful time happens soon after eating lunch.
quests.explanation: 1:00 PM is in the early afternoon, a cozy time for a nap.
quests.funFact: At 1:00 PM, an afternoon nap helps children feel bright and happy.

quests.instruction: We splash and play with bubbles in a warm bath. What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens in the evening, after dinner is done.
quests.explanation: 7:00 PM is in the evening, a bubbly time for a warm bath.
quests.funFact: At 7:00 PM, a warm bath helps children feel calm and sleepy.

quests.instruction: Everyone sits in a circle to sing the good morning song. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 AM
quests.hint: This happens soon after school starts.
quests.explanation: 9:00 AM is in the morning, a cheerful time for circle songs.
quests.funFact: At 9:00 AM, singing together helps classmates feel like friends.

quests.instruction: We help set the table before an afternoon snack. What time is it?
quests.question: 5:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens later in the afternoon, before dinner.
quests.explanation: 5:00 PM is late afternoon, a good time for a small snack.
quests.funFact: At 5:00 PM, a light snack helps children wait happily for dinner.

quests.instruction: We say goodnight and tuck into a soft, warm bed. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 PM
quests.hint: This is late at night, right before sleep.
quests.explanation: 9:00 PM is nighttime, a peaceful time to say goodnight.
quests.funFact: At 9:00 PM, a good night's rest helps children feel ready for tomorrow.
